record.question: What is known as the 'City of Arabian Nights'?
record.explanation: Answer C: Baghdad. Baghdad is conventionally called the ‘City of Arabian Nights’; the epithet is literary and not a formally defined geographic title. Reference: https://f5db1a33c5d48483c689-1033844f9683e62055e615f7d9cc8875.ssl.cf5.rackcdn.com/Yesterday%20Has%20Much%20To%20Tell%20-%20Ralph%20M%20Lewis.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: February 2019 (cover page; no day given). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
